name: Grief And Sorrow
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of grief and sorrow, portraying the believer's heartache and the deep anguish that can consume the soul, as expressed in Psalms 31:9. Yet, it also reveals God's compassionate presence near the brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering healing and strength amid weakness, as seen in Psalms 34:18, 73:26, and 147:3. The believer is reminded that life unfolds in divinely appointed seasons, including times of mourning and healing, pointing to God's sovereign care throughout all circumstances (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Ultimately, the Lord’s shepherding presence assures that even in sorrow, the believer lacks nothing (Psalms 23:1).
